context: Evaluates correct use of the spprof.profile decorator. Checks that the candidate applies the decorator factory with proper arguments, that the decorated function retains its return value, and that the output file is created automatically.

checklist.name: Decorator applied correctly
checklist.description: spprof.profile is applied as a decorator factory using @spprof.profile(...) syntax above the function definition

checklist.name: interval_ms specified
checklist.description: interval_ms=20 is passed to the decorator

checklist.name: output_path specified
checklist.description: output_path='compute_profile.json' is passed to the decorator

checklist.name: Return value preserved
checklist.description: The decorated function still returns the correct numeric result from compute(n)

checklist.name: Profile file created
checklist.description: After calling the decorated function, compute_profile.json exists on disk
